U RABON SINGH KHARSUKA 

La kha ia u Rabon Singh Kharsuka ha Mawmluh kumba ha 
ka snem 1840. La jer la thoh ia u ha kane ka jaka. 

U la ioh-lad ban leit pule ha ka Skul Mission ha Nongsawlia 
haduh ba un da pyndep ia ka Minor Examination. 

Ha ka snem 1864 la sdang pynkynriah noh ia ka Sor na Sohra 
sha Shillong. Ha kata ka por la donkam briew kiba nang kot nang sla 
ban trei ha ka kam Ophis ha Shillong. Kumta u Rabon Singh u la 
wan kiew sha Shillong bad ioh rung kam ha ka ling Shon Kot jong 
ka Sorkar. Ka dei ha kata ka por ba u dang shong trei kam ha Shillong 
ba u la ioh ka jingshem mynsiem bad u la kylla Khristan. 

U la iapoikha bad i Riangwe Lyngdoh Bu-am. Ki don ha ka 
Balang Mawkhar (Calvinistic Methodist Mission). U Rabon bad i 
Riangwe ki la im ka jingim Khristan kaba riewblei bad shitrhem ia ka 
Niam bad ha ka Kam Balang baroh. 

Ka jingkitkhia u Rabon Singh ia ka Kam U Blei ka la pynlong

ia ki Mishoneri ban khroh ia u ban iehnoh ia ka Kam Sorkar na ka 
ling Shon Kot bad leit trei noh ia ka Kam Nonghikai Skul sha la 
shnong ha Mawmluh. Hadien ba u la iehnoh ia ka kam Sorkar u la 
leit phai sha la shnong ban hikai skul bad i Menkmie jong u. Wat ki 
Sahep Mishoneri ruh kim lah khlem da iaroh bad pyrto ia ka jinglen 
lade jong u ban iehnoh ia ka kam Sorkar ba heh tulop da kaba leit 
long Nonghikai sha shnong ha ka tulop kaba kham rit. Nalor ka 
kam hikai skul u la kitkhia ruh ban pynroi ia ka jingnang jingtip 
shaphang ka Niam Khristan. 



Wat la u long uba kitkhia ha ka Niam Khristan, pynban u kdat 
ruh ia ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong u ban wad ban tip ia ka tynrai 
jong ka niam ka rukom u Khasi. U la pynshitom ialade da kaba kylli 
pyrthew, iakren ia khana, ia syllok bad ki tymmen ki san ban wad ban 
dh shaphang ka tynrai jong ka niam ka rukom u Khasi. Kane ka 
jingtrei shitom jong u da ka mon ka la pynlah ia u ban sei bad pynmih 
pyrthei ha ki jingthoh jingtar. 

Ngin shem ba u la ia shim bynta ban pynroi ia ka thoh ka tar 
lyngba ki jingthoh ba kordor kiba la pynpaw pyrthei ha ki Kot- 
Khubor barim bad ha ki kot jong u hi.

Khasi kaba nyngkong eh - “U Nongkit Khubor*' (Kylla Lyngkot 1893), 
shaphang “Ka Niam Khasi” ha kane hi ka Kot Khubor (naduh u 
Risaw 1893 ter ter); “shaphang ka Jingduwai knia” ha ka Kot Khubor 
U Hormurai Dicngdoh, “U Khasi MynteT (Risaw 1897); “Ka Por

“Shaphang ka Laitkynsew” ha ka Kot Khubor “U Nongialam Katholik 9

Synrai” bad “Ka Laitkynsew” la pynmih pat da u Bro. J. Bacchiarello 
ha ka kot, “Ki Dienjat Jong Ki Ijongshuwd' (1930).
